problem_statement: The NCP platform stubs otPlatDnssdRegisterHost and otPlatDnssdUnregisterHost as no-ops that discard all arguments. When a caller registers or unregisters a DNS-SD host on the NCP, no spinel request is sent and the completion callback is never invoked. Additionally, the spinel property for reporting the result of a DNS-SD registration request (SPINEL_PROP_DNSSD_REQUEST_RESULT) is not defined, so the host cannot send a result frame back to the NCP. The NCP must send a spinel INSERTED/REMOVED frame for the host when the platform DNSSD state is READY, invoke the callback with OT_ERROR_INVALID_STATE if the state is not READY, and process an incoming result frame by decoding the error, request ID, and callback pointer and invoking the callback.
